IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair pulled back
at the nape stands in a full-length pose. She wears
a fitted gray cardigan with a fitted peplum hem over
a pale blue blouse with a ruffled collar and a tied
bow at the neck. A pale blue A-line midi skirt with
small black dots, a black crossbody bag, and gray
knee socks with black buckled loafers complete the
look. Her expression is calm and composed. Soft,
warm studio light against a beige wall. Palette of
gray, powder blue, and black. Soft and polished, in
the style of a preppy spring catalog.
